title: The SingleCellExperiment Object and EDA
text: might typically install package CRAN install.packages(). Bioconductor packages hosted elsewhere different mechanism installing. First, ’ll install BiocManager CRAN, can use BiocManager install packages Bioconductor. well hosting, testing, distributing packages, Bioconductor also ships core infrastructure improves interoperability packages. usually come form data structures storing different types data. workshop, ’ll use SingleCellExperiment class. SingleCellExperiment object keeps different types data relevant analysis neatly organised one object. data point associated feature observation, might also want keep information, example: feature (gene) can named using different conventions, different aliases. observation (cell) might need patient ID, sequencing batch, quality metrics cluster ID attached. convenience, column data (data describing cells) can accessed using ‘$’ operator. can also store transformations raw data, e.g. normalised counts. Aaaand can also store embeddings data, PCA, TSNE UMAP. Finally, can store alternative experiments, modalities, measured cells. example, CITE-seq data measures gene surface protein expression simultaneously. might want treat separately rather appending main counts?
